name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Durotar, a young Horde hunter faces the last trial of Taming the Beast. Thotar in Razor Hill sends the hunter to tame an armored scorpid. Success grants the power to tame, call, and dismiss a lasting companion.

sections.title: The Final Trial
sections.body: A hunter must first prove they can command Durotar's harsh wildlife before traveling Kalimdor with an animal companion. Thotar trains hunters in Razor Hill and sends them to subdue three kinds of creature with an enchanted taming rod. Dire boars and swift surf crawlers have already tested them. Now they face an armored scorpid, a venomous predator with heavy plates, known for its resilience and speed.

sections.title: Bonding with the Wild
sections.body: Taming an armored scorpid tests focus and control under attack, not a hunter's skill at killing. Thotar urges hunters to meet the beast's quick, confident strikes. Once the scorpid is charmed, the hunter returns to Razor Hill and gives the taming rod back to Thotar. Then Thotar teaches the wild's innate techniques, so the hunter can seek out and bind a permanent companion of their choosing.

faq.q: What creature do I need to tame for this trial?
faq.answer: For this trial, tame an armored scorpid with Thotar's taming rod. It roams Durotar's arid red crags.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the armored scorpid after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: No. The armored scorpid is only a temporary companion and vanishes when you return the taming rod. Completing the trial teaches you to tame the wild beast of your choice permanently.

faq.q: Who initiates this rite of passage?
faq.answer: Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, oversees this rite for young orc and troll hunters.

faq.q: Why does Thotar want hunters to tame an armored scorpid specifically?
faq.answer: Thotar sees the armored scorpid as a model of confident, swift strikes and resilience. Taming such a dangerous predator proves a hunter can command wild beasts.

faq.q: What skills do you learn upon completing this quest?
faq.answer: You learn Tame Beast, Call Pet, and Dismiss Pet.
After learning to tame and call a companion, you can follow Thotar's direction to Training the Beast. There, you learn to feed and command your ally.

angles.text: As a hunter, this rite marks an early milestone. It grants you the core skills to tame, call, and command animal companions.
As a Horde youth in Durotar, you face its harshest predators to earn a place among the faction's scouts and providers.
As an orc, subduing Durotar's scorpids honors the belief that harsh terrain is overcome through unyielding will and martial discipline.
As a troll, you draw on keen instincts and a deep bond with wild spirits to pacify venomous predators that could strike others down.
